::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Mainland China's first fully-automated 12-inch fab (Fab 5, first wafers April 2011, built under the 'Project 909' upgrade lineage) and one of very few domestic 28/22nm logic sites (Fab 6, wafers since October 2018). In September 2026 Fab 5 formally merged into the listed Hua Hong entity (688347/1347.HK) via an ¥8.268 billion share deal — resolving the group's long-standing IPO-era same-competition commitment; Fab 5 contributed ~¥5 billion revenue and >¥500 million net profit in 2024.
:::

**Chinese name:** 上海华力微电子有限公司 / 上海华力集成电路制造有限公司 (Shànghǎi Huálì Wēidiànzǐ)

## What does this facility make?

12-inch foundry wafers at 65/55/40nm (Fab 5, incl. NOR/eNVM, RF, BSI plans) and 28/22nm (Fab 6, still outside the listed company under group ownership).

## Why does it matter?

Consolidates China's #2 foundry group's 12-inch base at ~a sixth of national 12-inch capacity, and keeps one of the few domestic 28nm logic lines — the node where export controls bite hardest — inside a state-owned structure. The follow-on ¥7.556 billion placement funds a ¥2.53 billion BSI and ¥562 million BCD program.

## Project Timeline

- **Apr 2011** — Fab 5 (Huali 1) first wafers — mainland's first automated 12-inch fab
- **Oct 2018** — Fab 6 (Huali 2, 28/22nm, Kangqiao) first wafers
- **Aug 2025** — Hua Hong announces acquisition of controlling stake in Huali Micro (Fab 5), fulfilling IPO commitment
- **Sep 2026** — Share transfer completed — Fab 5 becomes wholly within the listed Hua Hong company
